svg.text: Redrawn from Saab Service Manual 1975–1980, diagram p. 371-28/29 (PDF p. 406–407). Component numbers as in the manual. Dashed = not traced yet.
Bar 1–2 · parking and tail lights, fed from light switch 4
Bar 3–6 · live with ignition on, fed from relay 21
Bar 7–12 · always live, fed from battery / alternator
→ connector 58 at E12, then not traced
D+: 195 RD 0.75 → 47 charge warning lamp (instruments sheet)
Not RHD-specific: circuits should match, but harness routing and part positions may differ.
